articles.title: Crypto industry aghast at Illinois' new tax on holding or transferring digital assets in state budget
articles.snippet: The 0.2% tax on any business activity involving digital assets was added last-minute, and is unlikely to change, two people familiar with the matter said.

articles.title: Moody’s rolls out credit ratings on Solana in tokenized asset push
articles.snippet: The ratings giant is embedding credit scores directly into blockchain-based securities, a move aimed at boosting institutional adoption.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Bitcoin Cash (BCH) drops 3.1%, leading index lower
articles.snippet: Cardano (ADA), down 2.8%, was also among the underperformers.

articles.title: A new Bittensor proposal would turn validators into something like fund managers
articles.snippet: Root Reborn would have TAO validators pick which subnets to back and reinvest yield into, rather than constantly selling subnet tokens to pay stakers. It is a code proposal in review, not a live change.

articles.title: Bitcoin's June downturn leaves $8.6 billion in options out of the money
articles.snippet: Only 20% of June 26 options open interest is currently in the money, while bitcoin's 12% monthly decline leaves most bullish positions underwater.
